title: FROM Season 4 Episode Guide: Every Episode Recapped (S4E1-S4E9)
hook: FROM Season 4 premiered on MGM+ on April 19, 2026, with its finale set for June 28. Here is a grounded recap of each of the nine aired episodes, from the Season 4 premiere through the cliffhanger ending of Episode 9.

sections.heading: Episode 1 - The Arrival
sections.body: The premiere is fundamentally about how the town absorbs new arrivals and turns their appearance into part of its larger design. It reactivates the phrase 'Lake of Tears' from Season 1 as the season's central quest, shifting the mystery toward pursuit rather than mere survival. The key idea the episode establishes is that the town is not presented as a place where people randomly end up, but as a mechanism that processes arrivals like deliveries. Thematically, the hour stresses system over coincidence.

sections.heading: Episode 2 - Fray
sections.body: This episode centers on how incomplete communication becomes dangerous inside the town. A signal breaks through the radio static, but the town answers it with a warning sign, and characters mistake partial information for actionable safety. The major development is not just the signal itself, but the way confidence in a flawed reading of events leads to consequences. Thematically, the episode argues that the town attacks judgment as much as physical freedom.

sections.heading: Episode 3 - Merrily We Go
sections.body: The episode uses the season's 'Lake of Tears' phrase as leverage rather than resolution, keeping the quest active without delivering payoff. It builds around cheerfulness as a trap mechanism, with characters reading momentum as evidence of escape. The key plot turn is that apparent progress only deepens the town's control. Thematically, the hour punishes certainty rather than weakness.

sections.heading: Episode 4 - Of Myths and Monsters
sections.body: This chapter is about the creatures' ability to weaponize familiarity. A night creature mimics a human voice in an attempt to get residents to open a door, while Victor collapses in terror at the sight of the yellow suit, providing the first visual confirmation linking the Man in Yellow to the earlier community's massacre. That combination expands the threat from brute force to narrative manipulation. Thematically, the episode reframes the creatures as storytellers who borrow human speech to gain entry.

sections.heading: Episode 5 - What a Long Strange Trip It's Been
sections.body: The episode focuses on failed attempts to bargain with the town's rules. Marielle treats those rules as negotiable and is punished for it, while the broader plot turns movement itself into the trap. The key development is that momentum replaces geography as the mechanism of entrapment, so motion becomes a loop rather than a route out. Thematically, the hour shows that the town can convert action into repetition.

sections.heading: Episode 6 - The Heart Is a Lonely Hunter
sections.body: This episode is fundamentally about emotional need becoming a tactical weakness. A compassionate choice gives the creatures an access point, and the story establishes that loneliness functions like an open door because the town learns what people want and offers it back in tangible form. The central development is the clear link between grief, vulnerability, and breach. Thematically, it frames intimacy and longing as part of the town's attack surface.

sections.heading: Episode 7 - Best Laid Plans
sections.body: The Lake of Tears storyline moves forward here, with Jade and Tabitha designated as 'the two who must go down.' The key development is that even organized strategy becomes unstable, as plans built with human logic are answered by irrational consequences. That turns the quest away from simple destination plotting and into a test of how people behave under pressure. Thematically, the episode makes the Lake of Tears feel less like a location than a condition of trial.

sections.heading: Episode 8 - Heavy Is the Head
sections.body: The episode splits between psychological strain and a more concrete offensive plan against the town's structures. Boyd asks Kristi for medication to suppress a recurring gunshot hallucination, while Jade proposes a two-team operation to pull up the Bottle Tree and dig up the children's bones underground. The Man in Yellow warns Tabitha that unearthing the bones could either free the community or unleash something worse; Tabitha also finds Ethan's drawings at an RV the Man in Yellow decorated. Fatima develops black veins as fallout from her Season 3 storyline, and the hour treats leadership as a burden carried through uncertainty rather than control.

sections.heading: Episode 9 - The Calm Before
sections.body: This episode turns preparation into catastrophe. Fatima's vitals reach a medically impossible level; a daylight creature crosses Chloe's talisman line, steals Ethan's drawings, and kills Jim; and Boyd handcuffs Victor to the station to stop him from interfering with the Bottle Tree operation. An entity in human form states that it can only take the form of people who have died in the town, then coerces a town resident into acting as an inside operative. Tabitha and Jade descend into the tunnels and begin lifting a stone slab above what appears to be the children's burial site, at which point a voice addresses Jade by name - then cut to black. Thematically, every safeguard in the episode proves permeable.

sections.heading: Episode 10 - If a Tree Falls in the Forest...
sections.body: Airs June 28, 2026 on MGM+. No recap available yet.

faq.q: How many episodes does FROM Season 4 have?
faq.a: Season 4 has 10 episodes. The first nine aired weekly from April 19 through June 21, 2026. Episode 10, the season finale, airs June 28, 2026 on MGM+. Episode titles are listed on the Wikipedia article for the series.

faq.q: What is the Season 4 central mystery?
faq.a: The 'Lake of Tears' phrase, first seeded in Season 1 from a child's dream, becomes Season 4's central quest. Jade and Tabitha are designated as 'the two who must go down,' and the season builds toward the retrieval of the children's bones buried beneath the Bottle Tree.

faq.q: What happened in the Season 4 Episode 9 cliffhanger?
faq.a: Tabitha and Jade descended into the tunnels to retrieve the children's bones. As they began lifting a stone slab, a voice addressed Jade by name - a voice that did not belong to either of them. The episode cut to black. Episode 10 airs June 28, 2026.

faq.q: Who died in FROM Season 4 Episode 9?
faq.a: Jim was killed by a daylight creature that crossed Chloe's talisman line in Episode 9, 'The Calm Before.' This was also the first confirmed breach of the talisman protection established in Season 1.
